spans.s:
(A substitute for गो at the beginning of certain compounds, especially before words beginning with [Page0654-2] vowels or as the second member of Dvigu comp.; पञ्चगवम् five cows; गवाकृति cow-shaped). 
-Comp. 
-अक्षः 
__1 an air hole, a round window; विलोलनेत्रभ्रमरैर्गवाक्षाः सहस्रपत्राभरणा इवासन् [[

.]] °जालम् a lattice. 
__2 the mesh of a shirt of mail. 
-अक्षकः an air-hole. 
-अक्षित a. furnished with windows. 
-अग्रम् a multitude of cows; (written as गोऽग्रम्, गोअग्रम् and गवाग्रम्). 
-अदनम् pasture or meadow grass. 
-अदनी 
__1 a pasture. 
__2 a manger, a trough for holding grass &c. for feeding cattle. 
-अधिका lac. 
-अनृतम् a lie on cow's oath (अनृतगोशपथस्य पापम्); तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम् [[

.]] 
-अमृतम् 
__1 the beverage or nectar consisting of rays of light. 
__2 cow's milk. 
-अर्ह a. of the value of a cow. 
-अविकम् cattle and sheep. 
-अशनः 
__1 a shoe-maker. 
__2 an out-cast. 
-अश्वम् bulls and horses. 
-आकृति a. cow-shaped. 
-आलम्भः the cow-killing in मधुपर्क rite. 
-आह्निकम् the daily measure of food given to a cow; a kind of व्रत; निरुद्विग्नस्तु यो दद्यान्मासमेकं गवाह्निकम् [[

.]] 
-इन्द्रः 
__1 an owner of kine. 
__2 an excellent bull. 
-ईशः, -ईश्वरः an owner of cows. 
-उद्धः an excellent cow or bull; [[
A species of ox; गोसदृशो गवयः [[T. S.]]; दृष्टः कथंचिद्गवयैर्विविग्नैः [[

The wild buffalo. 
-लम् Buffalo's horn; गवलालिकुहानिभा [[Bṛ.
A kind of sacrifice (सत्र) lasting for a year; गवामयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः [[

__1 The chief cattle, a bull. 
__2 A cowherd. 
__3 An epithet of the sun; also of fire.

गविष्,
 
-गविष a. Ved. 
__1 Wishing for cows. 
__2 Eager (in general).

a. Ved. 
__1 Wishing for cows. 
__2 Desirous, eager, ardent. 
-ष्ठिः f. 
__1 Desire, eagerness. 
__2 Desire for fighting, battle.
a. of the earth; of the sky; [[

a. [गवे हितं यत्] 
__1 Consisting of cattle or cows. 
__2 Coming or got from a cow (as milk, curds &c.); गव्येन दत्ते श्राद्धे तु संवत्सरमिहोच्यते [[

.]] 
__3 Proper or fit for cattle. 
__4 Sacred to the cow, worshipping the cow. 
-व्यम् 
__1 Cattle, a herd of cows; गव्यं यव्यं यन्तो [[

.]] 
__2 Pasture-land. 
__3 The milk, curds &c. of a cow; [[

.]] 
__4 A bow-string; श्रवणोपान्तिकनीयमानगव्यम् [Page0655-1] [[Śi. 20. 19.]] 
__5 Colouring substance, yellow pigment. 
__6 The sacrificial act called गवामयनम्; गव्यस्य च तदादिषु [[

.]] 
-व्या 
__1 A herd of cows. 
__2 A measure of distance equal to two Krośas. 
__3 A bow-string. 
__4 A colouring substance, yellow pigment.

a. Ved. 
__1 Desire for cows; गव्यो षु णो यथा पुरा [[

.]] 
__2 Desire, fervency. 
__3 Desire for what comes from a cow (as milk &c.); अया धिया च गव्यया [[
a. Ved. Belonging to or coming from a cow; गव्ययी त्वग्भवति निर्णिगव्ययी [[
a. Ved. Desirous of cows; भ्राजा नैति गव्ययुः [[

a. 
__1 Delighting in cows. 
__2 Desiring cows or milk; गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः [[

गव्यूतम्,
 
-तिः f. 
__1 A measure of length nearly equal to two miles or one Krośa. 
__2 A measure of distance equal to two Krośas; [[

गवेडुः,
 
-धुः, -धुका A kind of grass eaten by cattle; [[

1 Ā., 10 P. (गवेषते, गवेषयति, गवेषित) 
__1 To seek, hunt for, search or inquire for; तस्मादेष यतः प्राप्तस्तत्रैवान्यो गवेष्यताम् [[

.]] 
__2 To strive after, desire ardently or fervently, make efforts for; गवेषमाणं महिषीकुलं जलम् [[Ṛs. 1. 21.]]

a. Ved. 
__1 Desiring ardently. 
__2 Desirous of combat; अभिमातिषाहो गवेषणः [[

.]] 
-णम्, -णा Search or inquiry after anything; सखि किमर्थगवेषणया गिरम् (किरति) [[
a. Searched, sought, inquired or looked for.
An epithet of Sañjaya, son of Gavalgaṇa; गावल्गणे क्व नस्तातो वृद्धो हीनश्च नेत्रयोः [[
